__comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recording of any site.
Reproduces the chapter-list API on the mobile host, which is the only
place a series' whole episode list exists: the desktop series page
paginates ten at a time (testdata/series.html).
**This fixture is in descending order on purpose.** The live API answers
ascending today, which is precisely why the fixture does not: a fixture
that agreed with the server would let a theme that never sorted anything
pass a test about sorting, and 'the server sorts it for us' is a property
of someone else's software that can change without notice. PLAN §7.2's
ordering contract is ours to keep. TestChaptersAreAscending fails against
this file if SortAndMark is removed.
It also carries the trap that makes episodeNo rather than the title the
source of the chapter number: titles read '[Season 2] Ep. 1', where a
number-finding heuristic returns the *season*. Ordering by that would put
season 2 episode 1 before season 1 episode 3 — a volume that reads out of
order, which is the failure the contract exists to prevent. The season
becomes the volume label instead, which is what M4 wants anyway.
One episode carries no exposure date, which must yield the zero time
rather than an error, and one title is padded by the template.
Why synthetic: see testdata/home.html. Host is example.invalid (RFC 2606).
